disposition.reason: This docket is an appeal of an Act 250 permit issued by the District #9 Environmental Commission, a state land-use permit, not a municipal land-use decision. The project (a retirement community with 30 cottages and independent living apartments) is new housing, but the appeal is not municipal.

evidence.quote: On October 6, 2006, the District #9 Environmental Commission (“District Commission”) issued Act 250 Permit #9A0314 for the Eastview Project
Eastview at Middlebury, Inc. (“Eastview”) seeks to develop a multi-level residential retirement community adjacent to the Porter Hospital on South Street in Middlebury
The Project will also include 30 detached single-story cottages, which will each serve as single family residences.
Act 250 appeals are heard de novo by this Court. 10 V.S.A. § 8504(h).

judgments.note: Both documents are captioned as an appeal of Act 250 Permit #9A0314 issued by the District #9 Environmental Commission; the guide makes Act 250 appeals municipal_appeal=no, so the case is excluded regardless of housing.
The challenged decision is a District Environmental Commission Act 250 permit (state), not a board's or administrative officer's municipal decision; the Town appears only as a party.
New retirement community with 30 detached single-family cottages and 37 independent living apartments plus assisted living units is new housing; it does not change the exclusion.

history.note: Excluded: Act 250 permit appeal (state), not a municipal appeal; project is new housing.
